email.title: Enter your email address
email.errorFormat: Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.com

code.title: Check your email
code.sentTo: We have sent an email to: [[email]]
code.body: It might take a few minutes to arrive. The security code will expire after 15 minutes.
code.label: Enter the 6 digit security code
code.errorInvalid: The security code is not correct, check your email and try again

phone.title: Enter your mobile phone number
phone.body: If you forget your sign-in details, we will send a 6 digit security code to the number you give us. This will allow you to get back into your form.
phone.label: Mobile phone number
phone.errorInvalid: Enter a mobile phone number in the correct format, like 07911 123456

expired.title: Your security code has expired
expired.sentTo: The security code was sent to: [[email]]
expired.body2: Ask us to send a new code, then enter it on the next page.

timedOut.title: For your security, we ended your sign in
timedOut.body1: You have 1 hour to finish signing in.
timedOut.body2: Go back to the service you were using and sign in again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.typed: If you typed the web address, check it is correct.
notFound.pasted: If you pasted the web address, check you copied the entire address.

serverError.title: Sorry, there is a problem with the service
